title: Ballistic Ventures seeks $490 million as AI-driven threats grow
teaser: Ballistic Ventures, a cybersecurity-focused venture firm, has filed to raise $490 million for two new funds. Of that, $360 million is earmarked for its third main fund—the same amount the firm raised in 2024—and another $130 million is planned for a separate vehicle, Ballistic Ventures Fund B. At the time of the filings, no share sales had been recorded for either fund. The fundraising comes as interest in cybersecurity grows: AI is helping attackers develop their attacks while also creating opportunities for startups that protect companies from such threats.
